items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: We had, uh, at one time, twin pianists. And, uh, Fate and I would play on, uh, one-handed band, uh, and Leving Good the other.

ctx.x: See, we were talking about Jay Barr's Loving Good. That's right. He's in Washington, D.C. now. He had previously lived in, uh, California.

And, uh, I just remember the other night that Captain Roy told me on the phone that he'd called him long distance phone and, uh, just wanted to talk to him again. Just had the urge of talking to someone he'd worked for many years ago, you know. He was, uh, and, uh, he was the extra piano player. We had, uh, at one time, twin pianists. And, uh, Fate and I would play on, uh, one-handed band, uh, and Leving Good the other. They were different types of piano players. Leving Good was, uh, more, uh, uh, up and down…
I guess many people had it then. I can't think of any bands that were featured. No, they didn't have it.
